description.narrative: Improve access to finance for MSMEs through credit risk mitigation and improved credit infrastructure

The proposed SIF operation aims to strengthen: (i) the Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund (DCGF) by enhancing its capitalization, technology, and institutional capacity to expand credit guarantee coverage, improve risk management, and introduce innovative de-risking products; and (ii) the Credit Information Center Ltd (CICL) by modernizing its technology and capacity to broaden data collection, integrate alternative sources, improve efficiency and accuracy, and enhance data security and privacy.

comment.narrative: The Project has not yet become effective. Despite the current implementation delays, the Project targets remain achievable within the implementation period.

title.narrative: Credit Risk Reserve ratio of DCGF

comment.narrative: The credit risk reserve ratio of 3.24 percent pertains to the half-year period ending mid-January 2026 and is marginally higher than the 3.04 percent recorded at the end of the previous fiscal year (mid-July 2025). During the reporting period, the uptake of credit guarantees slowed relative to the growth in credit risk reserves, which continued to increase through retained earnings. Once Project implementation commences, increased uptake of guarantees, higher revenue generation, and the resulting growth in retained earnings, together with capitalization of credit risk reserves, are expected to further strengthen the ratio. Accordingly, achievement of the target within the Project period remains highly feasible.
